content.rendered: DIVINE TIMING“Jesus saith unto her, Woman, what have I to do with thee? mine hour is not yet come.” (John 2: 4)That is the Focal Scripture of Streams of Joy Devotional today.When Mary besought Jesus that He may intervene in the matter of the couple in Cana of Galilee, Jesus reminded her that His hour had not yet come. Mary knew that Jesus had the capacity to turn that situation around, but she didn’t know when that phase of His life should begin. She knew the power of God was resident in Him, but she didn’t know the timing of manifestation. She had a revelation about Jesus, but didn’t have specific details.Friend, I pray for you: may God open your eyes to see specific details of divine timing and divine purpose. May God open your eyes to see where you are in the divine calendar; may God open your eyes to see details of the future that is yet to unfold; God will open your eyes to see what you ought to be doing in the future and even in the now; God will open your eyes to see divine specifics, so that you will not be confused about the times.In this season, God is in need of men who know what He is saying; God is in need of men who can provide direction for their generation on the basis of insight into divine plans; God is in need of men who can show the way for others to follow on the basis of what they have heard from Him; God is in need of men who will be watchers of time, and who can accurately tell what time it is in the realm of the Spirit.The time of living randomly with absolutely no insight into divine timing, is over. The time of seeing things physically without first seeing same spiritually, is over. The time of operating without clear cut instructions and divine perspectives, is over. The time of living like one who is merely waiting for tomorrow to unfold, is over. You were not redeemed to remain in darkness; you were redeemed to be the light and show the way.There is a generation waiting for men with divine insight and men who are accurate in their understanding of divine timing. Get deeper in your walk with God and He will reveal the depths of the Spirit to you.1 Chronicles 12: 32 says: “And of the children of Issachar, which were men that had understanding of the times, to know what Israel ought to do; the heads of them were two hundred; and all their brethren were at their commandment.”Declare With Me:Lord, grant me insight into divine timing, in Jesus’ name!Follow on Instagram @jerry_ezeFollow on Twitter @jerrystreams
